messages:
anya: quick RFC follow-up — thinking of adding a 'protocol translator' at the API ingress that accepts legacy v1 envelopes and rewrites them into the v2 internal shape. keeps client code untouched for an initial migration window.

jin: latency budget? adding a parse+rewrite step could add 2-5ms p95 depending on payload size.

leo: can we implement this as a separate stateless filter pool in front of the runtime? prefer not to touch hot request path for v2.

anya: yes — plan is a fronting translator service (separate pods) that routes to runtime. routing rule: if header X-Client-Version==v1 -> translator pool, else fast-path to runtime.

sam: rollout strategy? tenant feature-flag? canary?

anya: per-tenant gate + header opt-in. start internal -> 10% customers -> 50% -> all. feature flag key: enable.translator=true. allow tenant-scoped overrides.

jin: tests: need e2e for edge cases: nested arrays, unknown fields, streaming chunk boundaries (partial frames). add regression checks and fuzzing of envelope shapes.

leo: telemetry: emit translator.version, transform.latency_ms, transformed_fields.dropped_count, and a trace span for the transform stage. also a counter for bypasses and opt-outs.

anya: rough transform pseudo:
```
// pseudo-transform (simplified)
if (req.headers['x-client-version']=='v1') {
  body = unwrapEnvelopeV1(req.body)
  body = renameField(body, 'input_text', 'prompt')
  body = coerceEmbeddingsField(body) // legacy -> standardized list
}
proxy(req.withBody(body))
```

sam: escape hatches: some tenants rely on v1 quirks. add header x-translate=false to bypass, and a tenant-level opt-out flag. and an admin global kill-switch.

anya: agreed — add tenant opt-out, admin kill-switch, and a migrator report that lists requests hitting translator and fields dropped. deprecation timeline: announce 60 days before mandatory flip; keep translator runtime available for 90 days after flip for emergency rollback.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to cluster-az-2 for service api-ingress-translator at revision r42 :rocket:

jin: great — I'll add a test matrix (unit + e2e + streaming) and wire the metrics to dashboards. tagging ops for oncall playbook.

leo: I'll draft the short RFC update with checklist: rollout gates, telemetry queries, runbook steps, opt-out list. will post link to migration board.

sam: :thumbsup: from product side — I'll coordinate the customer comms and advisory blog. we should schedule a 30-min sync to align dates.
